retention_note: Compact copy of successfully recomputed processed metrics. No values refitted or recalculated during retention. Original raw stays at the source paths. Per-request histories and duplicated identities omitted to avoid copying token traces.

results.semantics: Host receipt times; pooled ITL quantiles descriptive, not independent step samples. All observed latency retained including failures; comparisons require both complete cells. Group legacy rates start at that group's first arrival; whole_episode_completion_rps uses the shared episode wall. No Oracle, no fitted counterfactual, no between-engine averaging.
